Title: GET /posts returns status 200 in under 3 seconds
Preconditions: The demo service https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com is reachable
Steps: 1. Run the plan `smoke.jmx` in non-GUI mode. 2. Read the results of the sampler "TC_SMOKE_01 - GET /posts".
Expected Result: Sampler "TC_SMOKE_01 - GET /posts" gets status 200 (response assertion) and answers in under 3000 ms (duration assertion).
